notes: The issue built the first general evaluator, 'grounded in the record', and was meant to teach the Phoenix judge process: rubric, golden set from two labelers, tuning a Haiku judge, and a corpus run. It grew from 1,772 to 2,774 words over 16 versions, all before the PR opened, as Joe's chat decisions were written into Do (for example I282-21, I282-25, I282-28 to I282-31). Task makes up 70% of the body, but many Do items are dated decisions with reasons and data folded in. The three struck questions' answers were already moved into Do or other blocks, so they are history (I282-13, I282-14), except I282-15, whose answer appears nowhere else. The PR description is 92% copy of the issue's Do and Done when (P283-d0 to d30), and its only new text is the results lines (P283-d32 to d36). Results went in two issue comments (IC282-0, IC282-1), not the body. The decisions comment is short: three of seven decisions say they were written into DEVELOPMENT.md section 5 (P283-c2 to c4), one went only into the issue (P283-c1), and two items were set aside with no issue (P283-c10, P283-c11).
